checks.text: On first load with no saved state, the page shows the heading "Sliding Tile Puzzle", the text "Moves: 0", the text "Best: 0", and the board displays tiles 1 through 15 in order with an empty cell at the bottom right.
Typing "42" in the field labelled "Seed" and clicking the button "New game" shuffles the board; the tile labelled "1" is in the top-left cell and the empty cell is in the bottom-right cell.

With the board in the solved state (tiles 1-15 in order, empty bottom-right), pressing the "ArrowUp" key moves the tile labelled "12" into the empty space, the empty space moves to the bottom-middle, and the text "Moves: 1" is displayed.
With the board in the solved state, pressing the "ArrowLeft" key does not change the board state and the text "Moves: 0" remains displayed.
After making 5 moves from a shuffled board, clicking the button "Reset" returns the board to the solved state (tiles 1-15 in order, empty bottom-right) and the text "Moves: 0" is displayed.
After solving a puzzle with 10 moves, the text "Best: 10" is displayed; after solving a second puzzle with 8 moves, the text "Best: 8" is displayed.
After making 3 moves, clicking the button "Copy state" shows a toast with the text "Board state copied to clipboard".
With the tab labelled "Stats" active, after solving a puzzle with 12 moves, the table shows a row with "12" in the "Moves" column and "Solved" in the "Status" column.
Reload keeps the current board state: after making 2 moves from a shuffled board, reloading the page shows the same board configuration and the text "Moves: 2".
